title: Daysaver Incredible: Taking bike tools to the next level

Daysaver Incredible: Taking bike tools to the next level

Despite being a relative newcomer to the cycling scene, Daysaver has quickly established itself as the gold standard for precision-engineered, cleverly designed multitools designed by cyclists, for cyclists.

The startup company arrived on the market in 2020 with the launch of its original multitool, and really Daysaver was created less as a brand and more as an idea: to provide innovative, high-quality solutions to the kind of problems that happen to cyclists of every kind while out on a ride.

Why? Because no matter what type of rider you are, and what – or where – you’re riding, bad equipment can spoil any ride, and all too often bike tools lack the kind of design and engineering quality we take for granted with other cycling equipment.

More than just the Essentials

Since the launch of its original multitool five years ago, Daysaver has grown into a company with thousands of happy customers and has distributors in more than 20 countries. Over that time its product range has expanded to now cover multiple product and carriage options, all of them Swiss-engineered to the highest standard and having been regularly refined and remastered to continually improve on the original premise of providing high-performance solutions to everyday cycling problems.

While the Essential line is there to cover basic needs, the Incredible range takes the original Daysaver concept of modularity and interchangeability to the next level, not only adding additional tools and bits but making it possible to carry them not only on your person or on the bike, but even in the bike.

All the base products in the range have the same form factor too, meaning you’re free to decide which tools you want to take on your ride and how you’d like to carry them.

Let’s run through the options in the Daysaver Incredible line.

Daysaver Incredible tools and pumps

Daysaver Incredible8 Multitool

The Incredible8 builds on the convenience of Daysaver’s Original9 and Essential8 Multitools by still featuring the proven allen key form factor, but with a retractable shorter arm that folds down for added carriage convenience. As a result, not only can it be carried in a pocket or backpack or be attached to the bike, but the retractable arm means it can even be carried in the bike itself using the Handlebar Mount.

The hardened stainless steel body ensures rock-solid durability, with an array of different tool bits to ensure ultimate flexibility. It comes with three regular double-sided bits – Hex 2/2.5, Hex 3/5 and Hex 4/T25 – and one single-sided bit – Hex 6 – plus a Hex 8 bit integrated in the tool.

The tool configuration can be changed using add-on MixMatch which can be freely combined with the patented lock-interface, so the tool can be adapted to any requirements. The following bits are available as add-ons: Hex 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 5, 6, T10, T15, T20, T25, T30, Plus (JIS), Flat head.

It’s the ultimate combination of convenience, adaptability and workshop-quality performance, and yet altogether still weighs in at just 57g overall.

Daysaver Incredible6 Multitool

Want the practical functionality of a host of essential Daysaver tools in a compact package that weighs just 51g? Look no further than the newly launched Daysaver Incredible6, the lightest complete tool setup on the market. It specialises in the one area that all cyclists come face to face with at some point: tyre repair.

The Incredible6 comes with a pair of tyre levers, Hex8 and Hex6 bits to remove the wheel, a tyre plug insertion tool, storage space for tyre plug strips and extra space for an additional single-sided, double-sided or MixMatch bit.

Of course, a simple list of features is only half the story. Convenience and usability are important too, and you’ll appreciate features such as the tyre plug tool screwing into the Incredible6’s main body to effectively turn it into a T-handle, plus the convenience of being able to side-load strips into the tool tip for easier puncture repair.

The Incredible6 shares the same form factor as the other core Daysaver tools, so can be mixed and matched with other products in the range and carried on yourself, with a pump on a frame mount or mounted in the handlebars.

• Find out more about the Daysaver Incredible6 Multitool

Daysaver Incredible Coworking7TL Extension

A superbly versatile add-on that matches the form factor of the IncredibleX Multitool, the Coworking7TL Extension is the add-on bike tool that ensures you’re prepared for anything. It includes a chain breaker and master link storage, a spoke wrench for common #0 nipples, a tyre plug insertion tool with a pointed tool head and side-loading operation for ease of use, as well as a valve core tool, plug storage and a blade to cut off protruding plug ends.

Like all Daysaver products, the Coworking7TL’s lightweight ergonomic design guarantees maximum adaptability and ease of use without compromising on build quality and durability.

• Find out more about the Daysaver Coworking7TL Extension

Daysaver Incredible Gravel & Road Bike Pump

When is a bike pump more than just a bike pump? When it’s Daysaver’s newly launched Incredible Gravel & Road Bike Pump. It fits perfectly with the seamless intercompatibility of Daysaver’s modular products, quickly and easily converting from its portable form factor into a full-sized pump while also being able to carry any of the other Incredible tools inside the pump.

Tyre pressures of up to 120psi are supported, and the pump works with any Presta valve – either attaching directly or via the add-on Screw on-Pull off Hose that screws directly into the tool.

• Find out more about the Daysaver Incredible Gravel & Road Bike Pump

Daysaver Incredible MTB Pump

Taking advantage of the Incredible line’s uniform form factor, the Incredible MTB Pump doesn’t just offer an array of pumping options for tubeless or non-tubeless Presta valves, but allows you to carry any of the other Incredible tools inside it, just like the Gravel & Road Bike Pump above. In this case, a lower maximum pressure of 80psi is in keeping with MTB tyres typically being run at lower pressures.

It’s available in two sizes – Regular holds a single tool, Large holds two – allowing you to have whatever you need on the go right there at your fingertips. Either way the easy pumping action guarantees effective inflation without the dreaded ‘tennis elbow’, the unit is fully protected from dirt and water ingress, and allows direct pumping by pressing the pump straight onto a Presta valve or a firmer connection through the Screw on-Pull off Hose – another of the Incredible tool options.

• Find out more about the Daysaver Incredible MTB Pump

Daysaver Screw on-Pull off Hose

The Screw on-Pull off Hose fits neatly inside the Incredible Gravel & Road Bike Pump or Incredible MTB Pump and screws onto any Presta valve to provide a firm connection between the Pump and valve that stays firmly in place even during intense pumping efforts, yet detaches easily thanks to a clever release mechanism. Screw on, pull off – the name says it all.

• Find out more about the Daysaver Screw on-Pull off Hose

Daysaver Incredible carriage options

Daysaver Pump Frame Mount

The easiest way to keep your Incredible Pump – and any other Incredible tools you have tucked away inside – within easy reach is by using the Pump Frame Mount. It fits to a standard bottle cage, and keeps your Pump securely housed thanks to the integrated clip and anti-slip rubber pad – no messing about with Velcro or straps. Even better, the adaptability of the design and option to fit it to any bottle cage mount means you can adapt the positioning of your Pump to your preferences and your bike’s setup.

• Find out more about the Daysaver Pump Frame Mount

Daysaver Handlebar Mount

One of the ways the Daysaver Incredible line stands alone among other bike tool ranges is the ability for them to be stored inside the bike itself thanks to the cleverly designed Handlebar Mount.

It fits any straight handlebar with an inner diameter of 17-21mm and with a straight section of 121mm, and attaches to the end of any tool in the Incredible line. The set screw enables you to adjust the Handlebar Mount to the inner diameter of the handlebar. That done, the tools are easily accessible via the quick release, ensuring they are stowed away securely but quickly at hand if needed.

• Find out more about the Daysaver Handlebar Mount

Daysaver Bar End

Details matter to any cyclist, so if you’ve chosen to slot in an Incredible multitool into your handlebars using a single Handlebar Mount (as opposed to one on each side), the standalone Bar End weighs just 8g and allows you to match the look on the other side to ensure you don’t lose any style points.

• Find out more about the Daysaver Bar End

Make it Incredible

Daysaver’s Incredible product line is the ultimate realisation of everything the company stands for – clever design, uncompromised engineering and modular compatibility in a package that weighs next to nothing and can be carried however you like – even inside the bike itself.
